hypothesis: In the paper's eight-cell active-inference model, free-energy descent run to a steady state reaches the target form (every cell at its own distinct target location with the correct identity) from every initial condition tried, and no non-target stationary state has free energy at or below that of the target form.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered. A run 'succeeds' if, at its converged state, (a) the RMS distance between cell positions and target positions under the best one-to-one assignment is below 0.5 x the smallest distance between two target positions, (b) all 8 cells have the identity (softmax argmax) of the type encoded at their assigned target, and (c) the smallest distance between any two cells is at least 0.5 x the smallest target spacing (no two cells share a place). Four families of 50 seeds each (n = 200): F1 initial identity expectations randn/8 with cells co-located (the SPM file's start); F2 initial expectations with sd = e^2 (the paper's literal 'log precision -4'), cells co-located; F3 every cell's identity expectation set to the same single type (v = +4 on one type, 0 elsewhere), cells co-located; F4 cells started at independent uniform random positions in the target bounding box scaled by 1.5, with random identities (randn/8). F1 and F2 are the primary families (the two readings of the paper's start); F3 and F4 are stress families. Supports: 50/50 successes in F1 and in F2, at least 95% successes (48/50) in each of F3 and F4, and no converged non-target stationary state with F <= F_ref + 1.0 nat in any family, where F_ref is the median free energy over all successful runs.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered. Refutes: fewer than 25 of 50 successes in F1 or in F2, or at least one converged non-target stationary state with F <= F_ref + 1.0 nat in F1 or F2 (a competing or deeper minimum, which falsifies the 'only' clause), or at least 10% of runs in F1 or F2 ending in a converged non-target stationary state (a reproducible non-target attractor falsifies 'guarantees'). Mixed: every other outcome, including 25-49 successes in F1/F2, 100% in F1 and F2 but fewer than 48/50 in F3 or F4, or a competing minimum only in F3 or F4. Inconclusive (reason 'other'): more than 10% of all runs fail to reach a stationary state within the maximum horizon, or the re-implementation does not reproduce the sibling test levin-2015-place-01 at 32 steps for F1 (fewer than 16 of the first 20 F1 seeds assembled by the pre-registered place-01 criterion), which would mean the model is not faithfully re-implemented.
planned_datasets: paper model specification: Friston, Levin, Sengupta & Pezzulo 2015, doi:10.1098/rsif.2014.1383 (claim-sources/levin-papers/inputs/2015-place.txt)

test_contract.expected_observation: Run to steady state, the model's free-energy descent ends at the target form (8 cells at 8 distinct target locations with the correct identities) from every start, and the free energy of any other stationary state is clearly higher than the target's.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: From some starts in the model's stated scope the descent settles in a different stationary state (cells sharing a location, or wrong identities), and that state has free energy at or below the target's, so the target is not the only minimum and convergence is not guaranteed.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: The generative model, generative process, target morphology (8 cells, head-body-tail, L = 2) and parameters of the paper and its public SPM implementation. MATLAB is unavailable, so the independent Python re-implementation from levin-2015-place-01 (morphogenesis.py, imported unchanged) is used: gradient flow on the Laplace free energy for internal states and action, not spm_ADEM's generalised filter. The 32-bin sensitivity ramp is followed by further bins with the extracellular-sensitivity ramp held at its saturated value (1.0); the exogenous gradient is kept on, as in the file. Seeds are independent of place-01 (numpy default_rng 1000-1049 for F1, 2000-2049 for F2, 3000-3049 for F3, 4000-4049 for F4).
test_contract.inference_method: Per run: simulate 32 bins as in place-01, then continue in 32-bin blocks with the ramp saturated until the largest absolute flow of v, positions and signals per time unit is below 1e-4 or 1024 bins are reached. Classify the converged state as success or non-target stationary state (converged but failing a, b or c) or non-converged. Compare free energy, computed with the free_energy() of morphogenesis.py, between non-target and successful states against F_ref + 1.0 nat. Count successes per family against the thresholds above; verdict by the tiers in pass_criterion and fail_criterion.

interpretation: 'The minimum of variational free energy is reached only when every cell is at a unique location and has correctly inferred its place' is read as: every stationary state of the free-energy flow that is a minimum is the target form up to relabelling of cells (cells share one model and are exchangeable, so which cell takes which place is arbitrary; 'unique' means no two cells share a place). 'So free-energy minimization guarantees convergence to the target form' is read as the universal statement that descent reaches that state from any initial condition within the model's scope, tested by sampling four families of starts rather than proven. A finite sample can refute the universal claim but cannot prove it, so 'supports' means 'no counterexample found in 200 runs', and the claim's mathematical form is not established by this test. The 'correctly inferred' requirement is 8/8 correct identities (stricter than the 7/8 allowed in place-01, because this claim says every cell). The exogenous gradient is kept on; its ablation belongs to levin-2015-place-09. The model's prior precision on identities and the log-determinant term mean the free-energy minimum need not coincide exactly with zero prediction error, so success is defined by the tolerances in pass_criterion, not by exact equality.
preregistration_notes: Written before any analysis for this claim was run. Before writing, the author read morphogenesis.py and the completed place-01 and place-05 results, which report 19/20 (file initialisation) and 14/20 (paper's literal log precision -4) assembled runs at 32 steps. Thresholds here were chosen with that knowledge: F2 may fail more often than F1, hence the 25/50 refutation floor for the primary families and the mixed band between.
Expected data_kind when complete: computational. A verdict shows the claim holds or fails for the model as mathematics, not that organisms minimise variational free energy.
